propositions: CI workflows must apply filter: blob:none to all tickets-store fetch operations to reduce transfer cost from multi-GB full-history to sub-100 MB blobless packs.
Standalone verify-identity and Gerrit verify-identity jobs must establish post-materialization pack-size guards at 102400 KiB and 131072 KiB respectively, failing if exceeded.
Named-origin plain git fetch and direct-URL depth-1/full-history fetches must negotiate filter capability over the wire and leave the known historical blob missing after cloning.

Real-Git protocol fixtures must prove filter blob:none is advertised server-side, sent client-side, and honored by git daemon with correct config inheritance via GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL and GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM.
Materialized tickets repos must preserve exact git count-objects snapshots before and after identity operations, guaranteeing no promisor object fetches during scanning.
E2E blobless tickets must reconverge independent local/remote changes via the ours driver, retain expected events, and push successfully without regressing merge semantics.
